content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: The vacancies are described as regular vacancies to be filled through direct recruitment of Surat Municipal Corporation, for the purpose of making a waiting list. The English part of the notice names no allowances.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection committee set up under Ordinance-185, as per General Board Resolution No. 429/2021 dated 27-12-2021, prepares the final waiting list. Based on each post's basic qualification and/or experience, the committee sets the criteria for a Written Test, Practical Test or Oral Interview. Based on the number of applications received, the Municipal Commissioner decides whether to call candidates for a written test, practical test or oral interview. That decision is final. Call letters are published on the SMC website, and candidates are told by SMS on the mobile number given in the application form. Candidates attend document verification, tests and interviews at their own expense. No allowance is paid.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for SMC Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Apply only online on the website https://www.suratmunicipal.gov.in . The online application opens at 11:00 AM on 30 November 2026 and closes at 11:00 PM on 14 December 2026. Study the information and instructions related to the recruitment, then fill in the online application form. Pay the prescribed fee with the online application. Then send the hard copy of the application, with two sets of attested copies of the documents, to the Recruitment department, Surat Municipal Corporation. SMC trainees and regular employees must also apply online. They must then send the hard copy, with a copy of their latest pay slip, through proper channel to the Recruitment department within 07 days after the last date to apply (office hours, holidays excluded). For more information, contact the Recruitment department on 0261-2423751-56, Ext-231/299. Candidates must fulfil the qualifications and conditions under the recruitment rules and examination rules of the concerned post.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in SMC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 23 vacancies: 2 Associate Professor posts and 21 Assistant Professor posts.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for SMC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 14 December 2026, up to 11:00 PM. Applications open at 11:00 AM on 30 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for the SMC Associate and Assistant Professor posts?
faq.answer: Apply online on https://www.suratmunicipal.gov.in within the window from 30 November 2026 to 14 December 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for Assistant Professor in General Medicine at SMC?
faq.answer: The qualification is M.D. in General Medicine or DNB in General Medicine, as notified by the NMC on 30 June 2025.

faq.question: Q5. What is the qualification for the Assistant Professor (Dentistry) post?
faq.answer: The notice lists M.D.S for the Dentistry post. There is 1 vacancy.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary of an Associate Professor at SMC?
faq.answer: The Associate Professor pay matrix is Rs. 1,31,400-2,17,100, with Academic Grade Pay of 9000/- and Pay Band 37,400-67,000/-.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary of an Assistant Professor at SMC?
faq.answer: The Assistant Professor pay matrix is Rs. 68,900-2,05,500, with Academic Grade Pay of 7000/- and Pay Band 15,600-39,100/-.

faq.question: Q8. Which department has the most Assistant Professor vacancies?
faq.answer: General Surgery has the most, with 6 posts, followed by General Medicine with 5.

faq.question: Q9. Are these regular posts?
faq.answer: The notice calls them regular vacancies filled through direct recruitment, for the purpose of making a waiting list.

faq.question: Q10. Whom can I contact for more information?
faq.answer: Call the Recruitment department of Surat Municipal Corporation on 0261-2423751-56, Ext-231/299.

faq.question: Q11. What is the selection process for SMC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Selection is by written test, practical test and/or oral interview, as the selection committee decides. Call letters are published on the SMC website.
